items.difficulty_reason: Reduce to stalks: identify the stalk of the glueing kernel via lemma-stalk-formal-glueing and a diagram chase (mechanism = the named stalk lemma), split by whether the geometric point lies in V (kernel = H_x, maps are isos) or over f^{-1}Z (flat local homomorphism with iso mod I); then bootstrap through the commuting square of categories relating QCoh(X), QCoh(Y -> X, Z) and the stalk-level Glue(O_x -> O_y, f_1..f_t) categories, whose flat affine case was dispatched to the More on Algebra glueing proposition - the external standing engine - and conclude both alpha and the quasi-inverse maps are isomorphisms.
